criteria: Leaders and militants of 20th-century national liberation and anti-colonial movements in Asia, Africa, Latin America and the Middle East (for example PAIGC, FLN, ANC/MK, FRELIMO, MPLA, the Viet Minh and NLF, Sandino's army and the Korean independence movement). Communists who led such movements may be included. Colonial officials, Cold War anti-communist strongmen, scholars of these movements, and leaders of elected socialist governments or post-independence rulers whose significance lies elsewhere are excluded.
